package.description: Language server and checker for PostgreSQL configuration files

en-US.description: Language server and checker for PostgreSQL configuration files
en-US.longDescription:
postern reads postgresql.conf, postgresql.auto.conf, pg_hba.conf and
pg_ident.conf the way the PostgreSQL server does and reports what the
server would refuse, as a language server for editors and as a command
that checks the files and exits non-zero when one is wrong.
en-US.name: postern
